operations.name: dataforseo_search_volume
operations.description: Real Google Ads monthly search volume, competition and cost-per-click for up to 1000 keywords in one call. This is the number every comparison-site, directory and free-tool proposal is otherwise guessing at from the wording of search results -- get it before estimating traffic, not after. COSTS MONEY per call, billed to the DataForSEO account; the response carries the exact charge in `cost`, so put it in the outcome. Batch every keyword into a SINGLE call rather than calling once per keyword -- the per-call overhead is most of the price. Read-only: it changes nothing outside this process.

keywords.describe: Keywords to look up. Max 1000 per call, 80 characters each. Batch them

locationName.describe: Full location name, e.g. United States or Sweden. Omitting it returns worldwide volume, which is rarely the number you want

languageName.describe: Full language name, e.g. English or Swedish

searchPartners.describe: Include Google search partner sites. Leave false for a figure comparable to what SEO tools report
